ranking_basis: Expected HOLDOUT-DTI information gain per implementation cost, using only data verifiably present in this checkout (data/bridge + data/scored_fleet). No score projection.

hypotheses.name: Fleet minority-consensus disagreement ring
layers: data/scored_fleet/*.tif (25 owner-scored binary rasters, SHA-listed in run card)
hypotheses.physical_signature: Per-pixel fleet support count S in [2,8] of 25 independent scored submissions: cells corroborated by a minority of independent methods but not the majority herd. Greedy 2.8 px Poisson-disc emission, highest support first.
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: Independent methods built on different physics (LiDAR scarps, tilt worms, Euler, Radon) agreeing on an off-catalogue cell (>3 px from mapped faults) is cross-method corroboration of a possible unmapped fault; majority cells are already herd-covered.
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: No prior lane in this repo emits from cross-fleet vote geometry; all prior lanes fit the native 19-band stack (absent here: .cache not restored).
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Shared fleet ancestry (many rasters derive from H19-5/D28 surfaces) can manufacture fake corroboration; also common DEM artefacts.
hypotheses.falsifier: Pooled HOLDOUT-DTI paired CI vs H33 control crosses or is below zero, OR leakage canary AUC > 0.90, OR uniqueness gates fire (>0.90 Spearman / >70% dots within 3 px of one registry raster).

hypotheses.name: Single-fleet-member residual (anti-consensus)
hypotheses.physical_signature: Cells with support exactly 1, restricted to the highest owner-reported member, spaced 2.8 px.
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: A lone method may see a fault class all others miss.
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: Not implemented; prior lanes never mined fleet residuals.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: One method's idiosyncratic false positives dominate.
